children: Fortis Healthcare on Wednesday said its wholly-owned subsidiary has signed definitive pacts with Seth Sunder Lal Jain Charitable Eye Hospital to provide healthcare services to an upcoming 400-bedded super speciality hospital in Ashok Vihar here.

The Healthcare Services Agreement (HSA), executed by Fortis Hospotel Ltd (FHTL), has a committed term of 29 years, extendable on mutually agreed terms. The hospital is expected to commence operations in 3-4 years, subject to requisite approvals.

Under the agreement, FHTL holds long-term exclusive rights to provide specified inpatient healthcare services, necessary clinical manpower, and specialised equipment such as Cath Labs, LINAC, PET-CT, and surgical robots in exchange for an agreed service fee.
FHTL will also extend a phased loan to the Society over the next 3-4 years based on construction progress.
The facility will be owned, operated, and managed by the SLJ Society on approximately 3.1 acres of land.
Fortis to expand Delhi-NCR bed capacity
“Pursuant to this, Fortis’ services would extend to more than 3,400 beds across the Delhi-NCR region going forward,” said Ashutosh Raghuvanshi, MD & CEO of Fortis Healthcare.

title: Fortis Healthcare arm inks pact to service 400-bedded hospital in Delhi
